# horoshop-mcp

> Unofficial MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects AI agents — Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and others — to online stores on the Ukrainian e-commerce platform Horoshop (Хорошоп). 118 stdio tools covering the documented public API, the admin panel and the storefront cart. One local process serves many stores; each tool takes a `store` argument. MIT licensed, runs on the user's own machine, credentials stay in a local file.

Key facts: Node.js 18+; install with `npx -y horoshop-mcp-server`; 47 read-only and 71 write tools; 57 of the write tools preview changes until `dryRun:false` is passed; not affiliated with or supported by Horoshop; admin-panel tools use internal endpoints that can change without notice.

## Start here

- [README (Ukrainian, canonical)](https://github.com/IgorShutko/horoshop-mcp/blob/main/README.md): what the server does, quick start, capabilities table, FAQ.
- [README (English)](https://github.com/IgorShutko/horoshop-mcp/blob/main/README.en.md): same content in English.
- [README (Russian)](https://github.com/IgorShutko/horoshop-mcp/blob/main/README.ru.md): same content in Russian.

## Tools

- [Tool index](https://github.com/IgorShutko/horoshop-mcp/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md): all 118 tools in one table, grouped into 17 sections, with access level.
- [Machine index (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IgorShutko/horoshop-mcp/main/docs/tools.json): one compact record per tool — name, section, access, dry-run support, call signature, link to the full page. Read this instead of the markdown when choosing a tool.
- [Per-section reference](https://github.com/IgorShutko/horoshop-mcp/tree/main/docs/tools): full descriptions and parameter tables, one page per section.
